purpose: Authoritative ARIA v2 Mission02 shared catalog and conformance vectors. Data only; both ports consume the same operation definitions after typed implementations land.

catalog.operation_identity_rule: id, effect, availability, description, help, schemas, and accepted_keys are one atomic operation record. Consumers must not combine fields from separate rows.

operations.name: moot_file_memory
operations.description: File a durable memory with explicit subject and placement.

help.intent: File a durable memory with explicit subject and placement.

operations.name: moot_memory_search
operations.description: Search memories by a query or an anchor, returning compact retrieval rows.

help.intent: Search memories by a query or an anchor, returning compact retrieval rows.

filter.description: Scope recall by confirmation state or feature flag. 'pinned' constrains to user-pinned memories. Composable with wing and media_type.

door.description: Scoring strategy adjective. 'guess' reads the optimizer-provisioned A1 per-corpus config. Direct values (rrf, matrixAware, raw, discriminative) override it. Absent falls through to scoring, then A1 manifest, then matrixAware.

ordering.description: Result ordering. 'byRelevanceDesc' routes through the scored recall pipeline (results are relevance-ordered by score). 'byCaptureTimeDesc' (default), 'byCaptureTimeAsc', 'byRoomAsc' use the LocusKit ordering field.

explain.description: Opt-in flag. When true, appends a discrimination: control line when recall confidence is low or medium, surfacing how clearly the top result separates from the field. Absent or false suppresses the line.

answer.description: Response shape adjective. "never" (default) returns dense rows only. "always" composes an answer block and rows (requires estate content). "auto" lets the server choose the response level by confidence gate (L0 answer-only, L1 answer+rows, or rowsOnly).

uuid.ordering: UUID bytes ascending; never display-case or request-order dependent

memory_list.next_cursor_rule: has_more=true requires next_cursor; final and empty pages omit it

dataset_query.where: object-only strict predicate; omission alone means no predicate

capability_digest.canonical_json: UTF-8; recursively lexicographic object keys; arrays retain catalog order; numbers use canonical JSON number rendering; no insignificant whitespace; volatile build and estate state omitted.
capability_digest.input: sorted effective operation definitions including id, name, schemas, effect, availability, and help/recipe bindings.
capability_digest.scope: digest only the visible feature/lane catalog; public lanes never include unavailable first-party definitions.
